label: PF Backlog 527
title: C2: Privacy controls (DPDP/GDPR) - data-subject rights, retention, DPIA, consent as a gate + artifacts
body:
## Acceptance criteria
A privacy-controls config + gate for generated products: data inventory/PII, data-subject rights (access/erasure),
retention policy, DPIA checklist, consent record; fail-closed. Wired to legal-privacy + guardrails(PII).

## Out of scope
Legal advice.
